summary.independent_sample_size_warning: Distinct coin-days, but coins can share a market date; not independent trials.
summary.protocol: Seeded sample of existing held-out coin-days with explicit ticker and cached bearish probability >=0.5; one random post per selected coin-day. Fresh sentiment inference, frozen JSON coefficient prediction. No retraining or outcome-based selection.
summary.target: Next UTC day's open-to-close, not 24 hours after the tweet.
summary.single_post_warning: Single-post diagnostic replaces daily social aggregates with one post while keeping historical market features fixed. It is not the original full-context forecast or a model trained specifically for single tweets.
summary.disclaimer: Historical hypothetical direction signals only. No fees, execution, position sizing or profitability validation. This project is a prototype and is not financial advice.
